title: Bootstrap minimal AI execution for Learning Loop V2
purpose: Extend the accepted Remote Agent Worktree with one fixed-profile read-only ANALYZE mode and Learn-it Next validation profiles, while preserving the exact-tested-result IMPLEMENT path and authorizing no product implementation yet.

baseline.candidateName: Learning Loop V2 minimal AI bootstrap

invariants: The bootstrap changes at most eight repository paths and at most 1500 added plus deleted lines.
ANALYZE accepts only fixed versioned profiles and never accepts caller-supplied shell, command, script, plugin or environment content.
ANALYZE runs in the read-token job and never reaches a write-token job or creates a result commit.
IMPLEMENT preserves the exact base, path budget, patch validation, no-credential test execution, separate result commit and exact tested-result status guarantees.
The Learn-it Next CI bootstrap exception is bound to the exact branch and exact eight-path allowlist and runs only governance plus Remote Agent tests.
Neither mode writes directly to main or merges a pull request.
No Learning Loop V2 product source is changed by this bootstrap.
The exact built Learn-it Next HTML is included when a fixed profile produces it.
requiredEvidence: PR scope validation PASS on the exact bootstrap head
Learn-it Next CI exact bootstrap follow-up PASS
Remote Agent bootstrap unit tests PASS
adversarialTests: reject a non-full or uppercase base commit SHA
reject an unknown analyze or implement profile
reject command, commands, shell or any unsupported job field
reject an ANALYZE request containing a patch
reject calling apply, package or commit-prepare for ANALYZE
reject implementation paths outside allowedPaths or inside permanent forbidden paths
skip every write-token job after a successful ANALYZE run
reject any bootstrap CI path set different from the exact eight-path allowlist
preserve branch-moved, digest-mismatch and final-scope checks for IMPLEMENT
nonGoals: build a generic AI execution platform
create an agent scheduler or orchestrator
grant autonomous merge or release authority
implement Learning Loop V2 product behavior
activate backend, accounts, cloud synchronization, marketplace, commerce or tenancy
independentReview: Learn-it Next CI targeted bootstrap follow-up
Linus code review of permission separation and compatibility
one read-only end-to-end analysis smoke run before bootstrap acceptance

programAfterBootstrap.name: LEARNING-LOOP-V2
programAfterBootstrap.activationGate: Bootstrap accepted and exact snapshot evidence reviewed

rollback: Revert the bootstrap pull request. Existing P1 product source, accepted post-merge artifact, Remote Agent v1 implementation lane and repository data remain unchanged; analysis-only branches can be closed without migration.
